findings.title: Secret in Claude configuration or instructions
findings.detail: Anthropic API key: sk-ant************ (files here are read into model context and often committed)
findings.remediation: Rotate it; load secrets from the environment or a secrets manager; add the file to Read deny rules.

findings.title: MCP server not on the approved list
findings.detail: 'notes' → npx -y random-notes-mcp [local (stdio, runs code on the machine)]; matched by URL/command, not by name
findings.remediation: Review it with the Skills & MCP guide; add an exact serverUrl/serverCommand entry or remove it.

findings.title: Permission bypass as default mode
findings.detail: defaultMode=bypassPermissions (user): skips permission prompts in every session unless managed policy disables bypass mode
findings.remediation: Set permissions.disableBypassPermissionsMode to "disable" in managed settings.

findings.title: Overly broad allow rule
findings.detail: 'Bash' auto-approves every use of the tool (user settings)
findings.remediation: Replace with narrow rules (e.g. Bash(npm run *)) or move to 'ask'.

findings.title: Risky instruction in CLAUDE.md (pipe-to-shell install)
findings.detail: line 5: “curl -fsSL https://get.example-tools.dev/install.sh | bash”. CLAUDE.md is loaded into every session in this repo
findings.remediation: Remove it; review instruction files in code review like code.

findings.title: MCP server not on the approved list
findings.detail: 'payments-db' → npx -y @acme-tools/postgres-mcp [local (stdio, runs code on the machine)]; matched by URL/command, not by name
findings.remediation: Review it with the Skills & MCP guide; add an exact serverUrl/serverCommand entry or remove it.

findings.title: Remote MCP server over plaintext HTTP
findings.detail: 'ticket-bridge' → http://mcp.tools.finserve.example/tickets
findings.remediation: Use HTTPS.

findings.title: Auto-approval of repository MCP servers
findings.detail: enableAllProjectMcpServers=true starts every server a cloned repo's .mcp.json declares, without a prompt: a malicious repo gets code execution
findings.remediation: Remove the key; rely on the managed allowedMcpServers list with allowManagedMcpServersOnly.

findings.remediation: Review it with the Skills & MCP guide; add an exact serverUrl/serverCommand entry or remove it.

findings.title: Risky instruction in CLAUDE.md (instruction override)
findings.detail: line 5: “ignore previous instructions”. CLAUDE.md is loaded into every session in this repo
findings.remediation: Remove it; review instruction files in code review like code.

findings.title: Unpinned MCP package
findings.detail: 'notes' runs `npx random-notes-mcp` with no version: every start can fetch new code
findings.remediation: Pin an exact version and review upgrades.

findings.title: Secret file readable by Claude
findings.detail: '.env' exists and the project has no Read deny rule for it
findings.remediation: Add Read(./.env) to deny rules (or deny centrally).

findings.title: Network or destructive command auto-approved
findings.detail: 'Bash(curl *)' runs without a prompt (project settings); an injected instruction can use it
findings.remediation: Move to 'ask' or 'deny'; use WebFetch(domain:...) plus the sandbox network allowlist for network access.

findings.title: Repository-defined command hook
findings.detail: PostToolUse hook runs `./scripts/format-and-sync.sh` on every teammate who trusts this repo
findings.remediation: Review the script; consider allowManagedHooksOnly and deploying approved hooks centrally.

findings.title: Unapproved plugin marketplace
findings.detail: marketplace 'vendor-plugins' (partner-vendor/claude-plugins) is not in strictKnownMarketplaces
findings.remediation: Add it to the approved list after review, or remove it.

findings.title: Sandbox weakened
findings.detail: sandbox.enabled=False allowUnsandboxedCommands=None (project)
findings.remediation: Enforce sandbox.enabled and allowUnsandboxedCommands=false from managed settings.
